name: io.github.PSPDFKit/nutrient-document-engine-mcp-server
title: Nutrient Document Engine MCP Server
description: MCP server for self-hosted Nutrient Document Engine: extract, edit, redact, and annotate documents.

environmentVariables.name: DOCUMENT_ENGINE_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.name: DOCUMENT_ENGINE_API_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API auth token for your Document Engine instance.

environmentVariables.name: DASHBOARD_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional: enables the local status dashboard (Basic auth username).
